[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Next Greater Element III** [LC 556 · Next Greater Element III](https://leetcode.com/problems/next-greater-element-iii/){difficulty="Medium"}

Read `n` as its string of digits. For strings of the same length, numeric order is lexicographic order, so "the smallest larger number with the same digits" is exactly the next permutation of the digit string (@sec-part-p3-a), except that there is no wrap-around (no pivot means $-1$) and the result must fit in 32 bits.

[Solved in full in @sec-part-p3-b.]{.card-link}

:::
